events.title: BitConnect collapses

research.summary: BitConnect announced the immediate closure of its lending operation and said its exchange would also close, after regulatory pressure and a collapsing market price.
research.significance: The implosion became one of crypto's most notorious fraud-era collapses and turned BitConnect's promoter culture into enduring internet lore.

sources.title: BitConnect — Halt of lending and exchange platform

events.title: Uniswap launches

research.summary: Hayden Adams publicly announced and deployed Uniswap to Ethereum mainnet on 2 November 2018.
research.significance: Uniswap's automated market maker model became foundational DeFi infrastructure and changed decentralized exchange design.

sources.title: Uniswap — A Short History of Uniswap

events.title: Coincheck hack

research.summary: Coincheck disclosed that 526,300,010 XEM had been transferred out after attackers compromised its environment and obtained NEM private keys.
research.significance: The theft was one of the largest exchange hacks of its era and triggered major scrutiny of Japanese exchange security.

events.title: Bitcoin Cash hash war leads to BCH/BSV split

research.summary: Bitcoin Cash underwent a contentious hard fork that produced two competing networks, Bitcoin ABC/BCH and Bitcoin SV.
research.significance: The split was the defining second-generation fork war and showed how mining power, personalities and incompatible protocol visions could fracture an already-forked chain.

sources.title: CoinDesk — Bitcoin Cash Just Split Into Two Blockchains

events.title: Dai's first-year adoption — nearly 80 million reported in circulation

research.summary: MakerDAO's first-anniversary report said nearly 80 million Dai were in circulation after its first year.
research.significance: A sourced snapshot of early stablecoin adoption, retained as context for the Dai launch.

sources.title: MakerDAO — Happy BirthDAI
sources.supports: 18 December first-anniversary report, nearly 80 million Dai circulation and retrospective community activity.

research.notes: Issuer-reported snapshot dated 18 December. It does not establish a new launch or prove the peg never deviated. Exact supply threshold-crossing time is not claimed.

events.title: US SEC increases enforcement against unregistered ICOs

research.summary: SEC enforcement broadened materially during 2018 after the DAO Report, including fraud, unregistered offerings and paid-promotion cases.
research.significance: The enforcement wave transformed the ICO boom into a major securities-law battleground.

sources.title: SEC — Digital Asset Transactions: When Howey Met Gary

events.title: Pineapple Fund completes a major Bitcoin philanthropy campaign

research.summary: The anonymous Pineapple Fund completed a large Bitcoin-funded philanthropy campaign across dozens of charities, including multimillion-dollar donations to organizations such as MAPS.
research.significance: It became one of the most memorable examples of early crypto wealth being converted into large-scale philanthropy.

events.title: USDC launches

research.summary: Circle and the CENTRE consortium launched USD Coin (USDC), with Circle as the first commercial issuer.
research.significance: USDC became one of crypto's most important regulated dollar stablecoins and a major settlement asset across exchanges, DeFi and payments.

events.title: WalletConnect begins building wallet-to-dapp connectivity

research.summary: Pedro Gomes founded WalletConnect in 2018 to let wallets and applications establish encrypted connections, initially through a QR-code-based flow.
research.significance: WalletConnect became a standard interoperability layer for connecting self-custody wallets to decentralized applications.

events.title: Pineapple Fund completes a major Bitcoin philanthropy campaign

research.summary: This is the same Pineapple Fund philanthropy campaign as LORE-EVT-0181.
research.significance: Canonicalized to LORE-EVT-0181.

events.title: ERC-721 proposal begins standardizing NFTs

research.summary: EIP-721 was created on 24 January 2018, defining a standard interface for non-fungible tokens on Ethereum.
research.significance: ERC-721 standardized NFT interoperability across wallets, marketplaces and applications and became the defining token interface for the NFT boom.

events.title: Lightning Network mainnet usage begins expanding

research.summary: Lightning Labs released lnd 0.4-beta, its first Lightning implementation designated for Bitcoin mainnet use.
research.significance: The release marked the transition of Lightning from research and test networks toward real-money Bitcoin payment-channel infrastructure.

sources.title: Lightning Labs — first Lightning mainnet beta

events.title: Tether briefly loses its dollar peg amid banking concerns

research.summary: Tether traded materially below its $1 target amid banking and reserve concerns before recovering.
research.significance: The event was one of the first major stress tests of the dominant centralized crypto stablecoin and showed how stablecoin confidence can affect the wider market.

events.title: US SEC says Bitcoin and Ether are treated differently from many ICO tokens in public remarks

research.summary: SEC Corporation Finance Director William Hinman said that, based on his understanding of the then-current decentralized networks, current offers and sales of Bitcoin and Ether were not securities transactions.
research.significance: The speech became one of the most influential US regulatory statements of the era, while remaining staff-level analysis rather than a Commission rule.

sources.title: SEC — Digital Asset Transactions: When Howey Met Gary

events.title: India central bank restricts banking services for crypto businesses

research.summary: The Reserve Bank of India directed regulated financial institutions not to provide services dealing with virtual currencies and to exit existing relationships.
research.significance: The banking restriction sharply constrained India's domestic crypto industry until the Supreme Court set it aside in March 2020.

events.title: South Korea real-name crypto trading-account policy takes effect

research.summary: South Korea's real-name bank-account policy for cryptocurrency trading took effect on 30 January 2018.
research.significance: The rule became a major example of a government tightening crypto market access through banking and AML controls rather than imposing an outright ban.

sources.title: Korea FSC — Financial Measures to Curb Speculation in Cryptocurrency Trading

events.title: Ohio announces Bitcoin option for some business tax payments

research.summary: Ohio's Treasurer began accepting Bitcoin for selected business-tax payments through OhioCrypto.com.
research.significance: It was a notable US state-government experiment with Bitcoin as a payment rail for taxes, even though the program was later discontinued.

sources.title: Ohio Department of Taxation — Cryptocurrency business tax payments

events.title: Vitalik publishes ZK-SNARK batch-validation scaling proposal

research.summary: Vitalik Buterin proposed batching asset-transfer operations, proving their validity with a ZK-SNARK and publishing compressed transaction data on Ethereum.
research.significance: A concrete research milestone in the development of rollup-style scaling.

sources.title: Ethereum Research / Vitalik Buterin — On-chain scaling to potentially ~500 tx/sec through mass tx validation
sources.supports: Dated proposal, validity proofs and compressed on-chain transaction data.

research.notes: This is a research proposal, not a deployed rollup. The throughput in the post title is an estimate, not measured mainnet performance. Do not claim this was the sole invention or first-ever rollup.

events.title: Telegram Open Network private sale becomes one of the largest token raises

research.summary: Telegram sold contractual rights to future Gram tokens in two private rounds that raised roughly $1.7 billion.
research.significance: It was among the largest token financings of the era and later became a landmark securities case.

events.title: SEC launches high-profile enforcement against celebrity ICO promotions

research.summary: The SEC charged Floyd Mayweather Jr. and DJ Khaled for failing to disclose payments received for promoting ICOs.
research.significance: These were the SEC's first ICO touting cases and established a highly visible precedent for celebrity crypto promotions.

events.title: Coincheck reimbursement plan follows record NEM theft

research.summary: Coincheck compensated eligible NEM holders after the January hack using a stated yen reimbursement rate.
research.significance: The reimbursement became an important exchange-response contrast to collapses where users recovered little or nothing.

events.title: EOS freezes selected accounts shortly after mainnet launch

research.summary: The EOS Core Arbitration Forum issued its first arbitrator order directing the freeze of seven accounts reported stolen shortly after EOS mainnet activation.
research.significance: The order became an early and highly visible test of EOS's constitution/arbitration governance model, showing that block producers could enforce human arbitration decisions on-chain.

events.title: Monero adopts Bulletproofs

research.summary: Monero's October 2018 network upgrade enabled Bulletproofs, sharply reducing confidential transaction sizes while also changing ring size and proof-of-work parameters.
research.significance: Bulletproofs materially improved the practicality and scalability of Monero's privacy model.

events.title: Zcash Sapling improves shielded transaction usability

research.summary: Zcash activated the Sapling network upgrade at block 419,200, greatly improving the speed and memory requirements of shielded transactions.
research.significance: Sapling made privacy-preserving Zcash transactions far more usable for wallets, exchanges and mobile devices.
